en:
Hey there. Guess I don't have
to introduce myself, huh?

I get that this is probably pretty confusing,
seeing...yourself like this.

Guess I should start from
the beginning.
That's the way it is.

Now, Monokuma probably already told
you this, but just in case...

This killing game will continue until
there are only two people left.

Now the important part of that rule
is that—

...Oh.
There is...one more thing.

Well, the truth is...
this isn't your first—

Anyone who finds out who you are is
gonna come for you...
So watch your back. Trust no one.
And never forget...

You wanted this killing game, so you
have to win no matter what.
...No matter what.
<CLT=cltMIND>The morning after the third class trial.

<CLT=cltMIND>After waking up from Monokuma's announcement,
I headed to the dining hall as always.
Good morning, everyone.
Ah...yeah. Good morning.
Good...morning...
*sigh*

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a dark mood in the air
of the dining hall today.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's to be expected, with
what we've been through.
<CLT=cltMIND>In a situation like this...

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't see how we all could
possibly stay enthusiastic.
<CLT=cltMIND>...Well, with two exceptions.

What's wrong, bro!?
You're not gonna eat!?

If you don't eat, then Gonta will eat you
instead, Shuichi.

Ah, he'll eat me?
Don't you mean my breakfast...?

Speaking of Gonta, where is he?
I haven't seen him this morning.
He's not here yet?
He's probably still sleeping...
*sigh*

<CLT=cltMIND>This atmosphere is heavy...
Everyone's really taken a mental beating.

Heeey! You guys have no energy! You need 
to look alive! You're all still teenagers!
H-Himiko?

Your "good mornings" are too quiet!
It's cuz you're so quiet that you feel down!
*SIGH!!!*
I didn't mean you should sigh louder!

...Weird. I thought you'd be the most depressed
out of all of us.

Of course...I'm depressed. This is the most 
depressed I've been in all my 200 million years.
200 million years!?

But...being depressed won't help those 
who died rest in peace...

Tenko and Angie, too. If I stay depressed,
they won't be able to rest in peace either.

So in order to make their deaths have meaning,
I've decided to live my live with positivity!

S-So anyway...
Please...t-take care of the...new me...

You're out of breath already. You're going
full speed right out of the gate!
But it's just like Himiko said.

Those of us left need to look to the future 
and live. For all the others' sakes.

Yeah! Let's cheer up and work hard!
This game is just getting started!
Game?
Huh? Isn't that what we were talking about?

Ughhh...but now that there's less people,
I might...be the next victim...

Woooow, so exciting!
But I definitely don't wanna die!

Well, I guess that's the same for everyone else!
Ah-hahahahahaha!

You're still saying crap like that 
at a time like—

<CLT=cltMIND>Just then, the door to the dining hall
burst open, and...
Everyone! This serious!

Oh, no... The Colossal High School Girl is on
the other side of the wall, isn't she!?

Okay, maybe not that serious, but Gonta
went to courtyard before coming here...

The graffiti?
Was more added to it?
Yeah. More letters added...

I'm not sure what it's trying to spell...
"The swords"? Or maybe "this world"?

Wh-What about the world? What does it mean?
Is there some crazy story going on?

It's probably just graffiti, right? We should
ignore it.
No, I don't think that's a good idea.
...Why? Do you want to die?
What?

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, right. That's just a habit of hers.
But my heart skips a beat every time...

No one here takes credit for it, right?
But now there's more added to it.
It must have some meaning.

So, seriously, none of us here wrote it?
If this is a prank, you better speak up.

But Gonta stumbled onto the writing by
coincidence, right?

If it was a prank, then they would've done it
in a more obvious spot, not in the grass.

There's nothing more depressing than an
unnoticed prank.
It's like a titty no one wants to fondle!

Well, it could just be Gonta writing it, since
he was the first one to find—

Gonta never do that! Gonta never make
trouble for everyone!
It's...ungentlemanly.
<CLT=cltMIND>What is that writing...
<CLT=cltMIND>More and more gets added...

<CLT=cltMIND>Who's doing it?
What does it mean?

Well, I don't really get it, but...
Maybe it's some kinda clue.
Thanks for the report, Gonta.
...Gonta just glad to help.

Gonta want to help, even little. Tell Gonta
if you need help with something, okay?

O-kay, got it! I'll let you know if I want
you to punch someone.

No! You don't get to tell Gonta what 
to do anymore!

Y-Yeah... Gonta learn lesson after
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Insect Meet and Greet<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
Tch, booooring.

Oh ho! My ears are burning! Are you guys
talking about me again? You must love me!

Hm? Are you getting dizzy from the face
I make when I concentrate really hard?
Your face...? It's always the same, isn't it?

Never mind that... You guys are probably
eager for it, right?
My prize, that is.

Right? You guys can't live without getting
a prize right now, right?
That's what I thought, so I brought a prize!
Rise and shine, ursine!
Huh? What's an ursine?

Oh my... Forgetting your catchphrase is
like the kiss of death for a mascot, y'know?
Hahaha! Cuz I'm a mascot! Get it?

That wasn't even a joke! There was no
set up, no punchline, no nothing!

By the way, who's this pink stuffed pig
and why is she talking to me?

Monotaro's head is busted! One solid
whack should make him remember!
Ouch!
Ngh? Where am I? Where's Kaoru...?

Ack! Your character is completely
different now!

Pops... My family... And you...
Thank you...for loving me!
C'mon! Remember already!

*sigh*... They're so adorably fascinating.
I could watch them forever.
I've had about enough of them...

Heeey, give us some lovin', tooooo.
I want my reward alreadyyyyy.

When did you get so friendly 
with Monokuma, Kokichi?
Okay, okay. The prize this time is—

Ta-da! The legendary <CLT=cltSTRONG>Levistone<CLT=cltNORMAL>, the
priceless <CLT=cltSTRONG>Octobrush<CLT=cltNORMAL>, and...

a <CLT=cltSTRONG>card key<CLT=cltNORMAL>! Which just so happens to be
the motive, too!
<CLT=cltMIND>Motive!?
Did you say...<CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>!?

Yep! This <CLT=cltSTRONG>mysterious card key<CLT=cltNORMAL> is your next
motive!

The classic carrot-and-stick approach! No
one can work a carrot or a stick like Daddy!

Screw your carrot and your stick!
Gimme whips and chains all the way!

A card key is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
What does that even mean?

So, the new area you can open with the
card key... Is that where the real motive is?

Puhuhu, that's a secret. Why don't you use
it if you're so curious?

No, we shouldn't. If we want to prevent
another murder from happening—
Yoink! I'll take that card key then!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi used his lithe body to his
advantage and took the card key from Monokuma.

B-But that Monokuma's <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>! What if
another murder happen!?
I wouldn't mind that at all, y'know?
What?

Cuz this is the killing game and we're the
players, plain and simple.
Why *wouldn't* the players play the game?
Quit screwing around and just give it to us!
No thaaaanks! See yaaaaa!
Wha—! Hey! Wait up!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi ran out of the dining hall,
pursued by Kaito.

Running in the halls isn't normally allowed,
but I suppose boys will be boys.

Also, I forgot to mention this, but I've hidden
another <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL> somewhere.

I wonder what memories you'll uncover next!
Happy hunting!
Huh? What's "<CLT=cltSTRONG>so long, bear-well<CLT=cltNORMAL>" mean?
You forgot that, too!? C'mon, let's go!

Wh-What should we do?
Kokichi and Kaito are gone.

We cannot leave Kokichi alone with that
<CLT=cltSTRONG>card key motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

But...aren't you curious about 
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>, too?

Perhaps we should all search together,
and look for Kokichi as well.

That's a good idea, but...let us look for
Kokichi while you focus on the search.

Right now, we need your skills as a
detective, Shuichi.

Right... In that case, let me hold onto that.
I'll look around again.

Nyeeeh, Shuichi's grown up!
He's become so reliable!

Now that you're so respectable,
I'll let you pet me if you want!
Oh, I see, so Shuichi gets that honor.

Shuichi is so amazing. Gonta wanna be
useful to everyone too.

Don't worry. When the time comes, we'll use
your body as a meat shield.
Okay! Gonta hope time come soon!
No... You should hope that it doesn't come.
<CLT=cltMIND>Okay, where to begin?

<CLT=cltMIND>I'll search for a place to use
these <CLT=cltSTRONG>mysterious items<CLT=cltMIND>.
Gonta happy he can be useful to everyone!

Gonta do his best to learn from Shuichi,
and be even more helpful!
...But what that message mean, anyway?

Someone...try to tell us something about
this world?

You should focus on the search, Shuichi.
Let us worry about looking for Kokichi.
I understand. I'll leave Kokichi to you.
Also, I don't mean to pry...

But I'm curious about the large wall and
doors near Miu's lab.

Granted, that's no reason to suspect it's
related to the prizes we received...

However, I cannot think of anything else
inside the academy that seems suspicious...

So if there was something suspicious,
wouldn't it be in the courtyard?

I cannot think of anything else inside
the academy that seems suspicious...

So if there was something suspicious,
wouldn't it be in the courtyard?

Why are you taking so long!? You should 
all be running around like teenagers!
Ah, right...

Hm? Could it be...that you don't know 
where to look?

Very well, I'll help you out! I'll tell you 
about a spot I sensed with my magic!
It's...

The pedestal in the courtyard!
That thing in front of Miu's lab!
S-So...you should check it out right away...

<CLT=cltMIND>Alright, alright, you don't
have to yell it at me...

<CLT=cltMIND>I hope she doesn't pass out from
exerting all that energy.

The spot I sensed is the pedistal in the
courtyard! That thing in front of Miu's lab!
Y-You should...check it out right away...

Ah, okay.
Thank you.

That reminds me...while I was walking here
this morning, I noticed something...

Doesn't the courtyard look different?
I feel like there's less grass.

Maybe the message Gonta found wasn't
the only new thing...

But perhaps, we can find other things, now
that there are less plants around.
The <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive card key<CLT=cltNORMAL>, huh...?

But is there even anywhere in the 
school to use the card key?

The only place I can think of is that secret 
door in the library, but I doubt it's for that.

Only two shitty prizes this time!? Man, these
prizes are getting lamer and lamer!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Dining Hall Rules"

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"You may eat any food you
find in the dining hall."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Please take responsibility for all utensils and
dishes used and clean up after yourself."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"The dining hall will be locked
during nighttime."
